character.name: She has a slight frame and is the only member of the team wearing rectangular, dark-rimmed glasses, which sit prominently on her face. Her dark hair is curly and voluminous, gathered back but allowing some texture to show at the top. She wears a sand-colored field jacket over a pale grey scarf or undershirt. A key detail of her gear is a black handheld GPS or radio device that is strapped vertically to the left side of her chest harness. Her stance appears contemplative and reserved.
